G3961.d: from a derivative probably of παίω (meaning a "path"); to trample (literally or figuratively):--tread (down, under foot).

G3967.d: from πατήρ; paternal, i.e. ancestral:--of fathers.

G3746.d: from ὅς and περ; who especially:--whomsoever.

G3738.d: middle voice from (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion):--dance.

G3860.d: from παρά and δίδωμι; to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit:--betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend.

G3715.d: from ὀρέγομαι; excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after:--lust.

G3958.d: apparently a primary verb; to experience a sensation or impression (usually painful):--feel, passion, suffer, vex.

G3702.d: from an obsolete verb akin to (to "steep"); cooked, i.e. roasted:--broiled.

G3878.d: from παρά and ἀκούω; to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey:--neglect to hear.

G3943.d: from παρά and οἶνος; staying near wine, i.e. tippling (a toper):--given to wine.

G3788.d: from ὀπτάνομαι; the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance):--eye, sight.

G3861.d: from παρά and δόξα (in the sense of seeming); contrary to expectation, i.e. extraordinary ("paradox"):--strange.

G3962.d: apparently a primary word; a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote):--father, parent.

G3948.d: from παροξύνω ("paroxysm"); incitement (to good), or dispute (in anger):--contention, provoke unto.

G3562.d: adverb from a comparative of the accusative case of νοῦς and ἔχω; in a mind-having way, i.e. prudently:--discreetly.

G3587.d: from a derivative of the same as ξύλον (meaning a razor); to shave or "shear" the hair:--shave.

G3534.d: from νίκη; a conquest (concretely), i.e. (by implication) triumph:--victory.

G3536.d: from Νινευΐ; a Ninevite, i.e. inhabitant of Nineveh:--of Nineve, Ninevite.

G3637.d: from ὀκτώ and ἡμέρα; an eight-day old person or act:--the eighth day.

G3685.d: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (, to slur); for which another prolonged form () is used as an alternate in some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of ὄνομα through the idea of notoriety); to gratify, i.e. (middle voice) to derive pleasure or advantage from:--have joy.

G3995.d: of uncertain affinity; a wife's father:--father in law.

G3844.d: a primary preposition; properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of):--above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with. In compounds it retains the same variety of application.

G3953.d: from παρά and the base of ὀψάριον; a side-dish (the receptacle):--platter.

G3630.d: from οἶνος and a derivative of the alternate of πίνω; a tippler:--winebibber.

G3911.d: from παρά and φέρω (including its alternate forms); to bear along or aside, i.e. carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to avert:--remove, take away.

G3592.d: from ὁ and δέ; the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun:--he, she, such, these, thus.

G3647.d: from ὁλόκληρος; integrity, i.e. physical wholeness:--perfect soundness.

G3771.d: from οὐρανός and the enclitic of source; from the sky:--from heaven.

G3925.d: from a compound of παρά and ἐμβάλλω; a throwing in beside (juxtaposition), i.e. (specially), battle-array, encampment or barracks (tower Antonia):--army, camp, castle.

G3617.d: from οἶκος and δεσπότης; the head of a family:--goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.

G3568.d: a primary particle of present time; "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate:--henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time). See also τανῦν, νυνί.

G3795.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of ὀπτός; a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e. (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment):--fish.

G3729.d: from ὁρμή; to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge:--run (violently), rush.

G3824.d: from πάλιν and γένεσις; (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration:--regeneration.

G3572.d: apparently a primary word; to prick ("nudge"):--pierce.

G3885.d: from a derivative of παραλύω; as if dissolved, i.e. "paralytic":--that had (sick of) the palsy.

G3937.d: probably by contraction for (a derivative of a compound of παρά and μένω); constant; Parmenas, a Christian:--Parmenas.

G3704.d: from ὅς and πῶς; what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual):--because, how, (so) that, to, when.

G3560.d: from the same as νουθεσία; to put in mind, i.e. (by implication) to caution or reprove gently:--admonish, warn.

G3807.d: from παῖς and a reduplicated form of ἄγω; a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue")):-- instructor, schoolmaster.

G3613.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of οἰκέω (equivalent to οἴκημα); a residence (literally or figuratively):--habitation, house.

G3710.d: from ὀργή; to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become exasperated:--be angry (wroth).

G3753.d: from ὅς and τέ; at which (thing) too, i.e. when:--after (that), as soon as, that, when, while.

G3518.d: of Hebrew origin (נֵרִיָּה); Neri (i.e. Nerijah), an Israelite:--Neri.

G3886.d: from παρά and λύω; to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled):--feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy.

G3678.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὄνος; a little ass:--young ass.

G3872.d: from a compound of παρά and κατατίθημι; something put down alongside, i.e. a deposit (sacred trust):--that (thing) which is committed (un-)to (trust).

G3618.d: from the same as οἰκοδομή; to be a house-builder, i.e. construct or (figuratively) confirm:--(be in) build(-er, -ing, up), edify, embolden.

G3826.d: dative case (adverb) of a compound of πᾶς and πλῆθος; in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously:--all at once.

G3780.d: intensive of οὐ; not indeed:--nay, not.

G3684.d: from ὄνος; belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass):--millstone.

G3679.d: from ὄνειδος; to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt:--cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid.

G3998.d: prolongation from the base of πένης; necessitous:--poor.

G3939.d: from παρά and οἰκέω; to dwell near, i.e. reside as a foreigner:--sojourn in, be a stranger.

G3814.d: feminine diminutive of παῖς; a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant:--bondmaid(-woman), damsel, maid(-en).

G3653.d: of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig:--untimely fig.

G3874.d: from παρακαλέω; imploration, hortation, solace:--comfort, consolation, exhortation, intreaty.

G3732.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὄρνις; a birdling:--bird, fowl.

G3683.d: from a derivative of ὀνίνημι and φόρος; profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a Christian:--Onespiphorus.

G3599.d: perhaps from the base of ἐσθίω; a "tooth":--tooth.

G3880.d: from παρά and λαμβάνω; to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn:--receive, take (unto, with).

G3774.d: of Hebrew origin (אוּרִיָּה); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite:--Urias.

G3636.d: from ὀκνέω; tardy, i.e. indolent; (figuratively) irksome:--grievous, slothful.

G3752.d: from ὅτε and ἄν; whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as:--as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while.

G3660.d: a prolonged form of a primary, but obsolete , for which another prolonged form is used in certain tenses; to swear, i.e. take (or declare on) oath:--swear.

G3563.d: probably from the base of γινώσκω; the intellect, i.e. mind (divine or human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication, meaning:--mind, understanding. Compare ψυχή.

G3564.d: probably contracted for a compound of νύμφη and δῶρον; nymph-given (i.e. -born); Nymphas, a Christian:--Nymphas.

G3843.d: adverb from πᾶς; entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event:--by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely.

G3759.d: a primary exclamation of grief; "woe":--alas, woe.

G3920.d: from παρεισάγω; smuggled in:--unawares brought in.

G3776.d: from the feminine of ὤν; substance, i.e. property (possessions):--goods, substance.

G3666.d: from ὅμοιος; to assimilate, i.e. compare; passively, to become similar:--be (make) like, (in the) liken(-ess), resemble.

G3722.d: from the same as ὄρος; dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn:--early in the morning.

G3523.d: from the inseparable negative particle (not) and ἐσθίω; not eating, i.e. abstinent from food (religiously):--fasting.

G3982.d: a primary verb; to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty):--agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield.

G3714.d: from ὄρος; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of χώρα) the Highlands (of Judæa):--hill country.

G3959.d: probably of foreign origin; Patara, a place in Asia Minor:--Patara.

G3855.d: from παρά and ἄγω; to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away:--depart, pass (away, by, forth).

G3853.d: from παρά and the base of ἄγγελος; to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin:--(give in) charge, (give) command(-ment), declare.

G3597.d: from the same as ὁδοιπορέω; travel:--journey(-ing).

G3570.d: a prolonged form of νῦν for emphasis; just now:--now.

G3726.d: from ὅρκος; to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin:--adjure, charge.

G3693.d: from (regard; from ὀπτάνομαι) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time):--after, backside, behind.

G3605.d: a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill "odor"):--stink.

G3999.d: multiplicative adverb from πέντε; five times:--five times.

G3697.d: from ὅς and ποῖος; of what kind that, i.e. how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent τοιοῦτος of quality):--what manner (sort) of, such as whatsoever.

G3829.d: neuter of a presumed compound of πᾶς and a derivative of δέχομαι; all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan):--inn.

G3542.d: feminine from the same as νόμος; pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage:--X eat, pasture.

G3622.d: from οἰκονόμος; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy":--dispensation, stewardship.

G3511.d: from a form of ναός and (to sweep); a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary:--worshipper.

G3782.d: from ὀφείλω; indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty:--debt, due.

G3986.d: from πειράζω; a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity:--temptation, X try.

G3501.d: including the comparative ; a primary word; "new", i.e. (of persons) youthful, or (of things) fresh; figuratively, regenerate:--new, young.

G3787.d: from ὀφθαλμός and δουλεία; sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching (remissness):--eye-service.

G3935.d: from παρά and hiemi (to send); to let by, i.e. relax:--hang down.

G3712.d: from ὀρέγομαι; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom:--fathom.

G3765.d: from οὐ and ἔτι; not yet, no longer:--after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not).

G3777.d: from οὐ and τέ; not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not even:--neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing.

G3898.d: adverb from the same as παραπλήσιον; in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly:--likewise.

G3658.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ and a derivative of the alternate of αἱρέομαι (meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. a multitude:--company.

G3901.d: from παρά and the alternate of ῥέω; to flow by, i.e. (figuratively) carelessly pass (miss):--let slip.

G3977.d: from a derivative of πούς (meaning the ground); level (as easy for the feet):--plain.

G3916.d: from παρά and χρῆμα (in its original sense); at the thing itself, i.e. instantly:--forthwith, immediately, presently, straightway, soon.

G3791.d: from ὄχλος; to mob, i.e. (by implication) to harass:--vex.

G3672.d: adverb of present passive participle of ὁμολογέω; confessedly:--without controversy.

G3936.d: from παρά and ἵστημι; to stand beside, i.e. (transitively) to exhibit, proffer, (specially), recommend, (figuratively) substantiate; or (intransitively) to be at hand (or ready), aid:--assist, bring before, command, commend, give presently, present, prove, provide, shew, stand (before, by, here, up, with), yield.

G3504.d: from νέος and a derivative of φύω; newly planted, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert ("neophyte"):--novice.

G3626.d: from οἶκος and (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper"):--keeper at home.

G3837.d: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of πᾶς; universally:--in all places, everywhere.

G3598.d: apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means:--journey, (high-)way.

G3864.d: from παρά and θάλασσα; along the sea, i.e. maritime (lacustrine):--upon the sea coast.

G3756.d: a primary word; the absolute negative (compare μή) adverb; no or not:--+ long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but. See also οὐ μή, μῆκος.

G3906.d: from παρά and τηρέω; to inspect alongside, i.e. note insidiously or scrupulously:--observe, watch.

G3604.d: of Hebrew origin (עֻזִּיָּה); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite:--Ozias.

G3817.d: a primary verb; to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than τύπτω); specially, to sting (as a scorpion):--smite, strike.

G3721.d: from ὄρθρος; in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break:--early.

G3643.d: from a compound of ὀλίγος and ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem:--despise.

G3871.d: from παρά and καλύπτω; to cover alongside, i.e. veil (figuratively):--hide.

G3793.d: from a derivative of ἔχω (meaning a vehicle); a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot:--company, multitude, number (of people), people, press.

G3509.d: apparently a primary word; a cloud:--cloud.

G3980.d: from a compound of πείθω and ἄρχω; to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice:--hearken, obey (magistrates).

G3851.d: from παρά and the middle voice of βουλεύω; to misconsult, i.e. disregard:--not (to) regard(-ing).

G3698.d: from ὅς and ποτέ; what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as:--when.

G3687.d: from ὄνομα; to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess:--call, name.

G3508.d: of Hebrew origin (נַפְתָּלִי); Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in Palestine:--Nephthalim.

G3810.d: from παιδεύω; a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner:--which corrected, instructor.

G3500.d: from νεκρόω; decease; figuratively, impotency:--deadness, dying.

G3558.d: of uncertain affinity; the south(-west) wind; by extension, the southern quarter itself:--south (wind).

G3548.d: from νομοθέτης; legislation (specially, the institution of the Mosaic code):--giving of the law.

G3539.d: from νοῦς; to exercise the mind (observe), i.e. (figuratively) to comprehend, heed:--consider, perceive, think, understand.

G3823.d: from (to vibrate; another form for βάλλω); wrestling:--+ wrestle.

G3608.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of ὀθόνη; a linen bandage:--linen clothes.

G3966.d: from πατριά and ἄρχω; a progenitor ("patriarch"):--patriarch.

G3792.d: from ὄχλος and ποιέω; to make a crowd, i.e. raise a public disturbance:--gather a company.

G3554.d: of uncertain affinity; a malady (rarely figuratively, of moral disability):--disease, infirmity, sickness.

G3869.d: from παρά and καθίζω; to sit down near:--sit.

G3595.d: from ὁδός and ἡγέομαι; a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)):--guide, leader.

G3882.d: from παρά and ἅλς; beside the salt (sea), i.e. maritime:--sea coast.

G3805.d: from the same as πάθημα; liable (i.e. doomed) to experience pain:--suffer.

G3708.d: properly, to stare at (compare ὀπτάνομαι), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear:--behold, perceive, see, take heed.

G3768.d: from οὐ and -πω; not yet:--hitherto not, (no…) as yet, not yet.

G3544.d: from νόμος; according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal (ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law:--about the law, lawyer.

G3919.d: from παρά and εἰσάγω; to lead in aside, i.e. introduce surreptitiously:--privily bring in.

G3670.d: from a compound of the base of ὁμοῦ and λόγος; to assent, i.e. covenant, acknowledge:--con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise.

G3640.d: from ὀλίγος and πίστις; incredulous, i.e. lacking confidence (in Christ):--of little faith.

G3649.d: a reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e. shriek:--howl.

G3648.d: from ὅλος and κλῆρος; complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in body):--entire, whole.

G3888.d: from παρά and the middle voice of a derivative of μῦθος; to relate near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console:--comfort.

G3695.d: from ὅπλον; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)):--arm self.

G3576.d: from a derivative of νόθος; sluggish, i.e. (literally) lazy, or (figuratively) stupid:--dull, slothful.

G3657.d: from ὅμιλος; companionship ("homily"), i.e. (by implication) intercourse:--communication.

G3816.d: perhaps from παίω; a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God):--child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man.

G3908.d: from παρά and τίθημι; to place alongside, i.e. present (food, truth); by implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection):--allege, commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before.
r: such things as are set before

G3723.d: adverb from ὀρθός; in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally):--plain, right(-ly).

G3646.d: from a derivative of a compound of ὅλος and a derivative of καίω; a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust"):--(whole) burnt offering.

G3654.d: adverb from ὅλος; completely, i.e. altogether; (by analogy), everywhere; (negatively) not by any means:--at all, commonly, utterly.

G3825.d: probably from the same as πάλη (through the idea of oscillatory repetition); (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand:--again.

G3661.d: adverb from a compound of the base of ὁμοῦ and θυμός; unanimously:--with one accord (mind).

G3790.d: perhaps from ὀπτάνομαι (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision); the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e. (figuratively) the brink of a precipice:--brow.

G3642.d: from ὀλίγος and ψυχή; little-spirited, i.e. faint-hearted:--feebleminded.

G3909.d: from παρά and τυγχάνω; to chance near, i.e. fall in with:--meet with.

G3921.d: from παρά and a compound of εἰς and δύνω; to settle in alongside, i.e. lodge stealthily:--creep in unawares.

G3892.d: from the same as παρανομέω; transgression:--iniquity.

G3546.d: from νομίζω; what is reckoned as of value (after the Latin numisma), i.e. current coin:--money.

G3933.d: of unknown origin; a maiden; by implication, an unmarried daughter:--virgin.

G3541.d: of uncertain affinity; a spurious or illegitimate son:--bastard.

G3778.d: from the article ὁ and αὐτός; the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated):--he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who.

G3730.d: of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset:--assault.

G3973.d: a primary verb ("pause"); to stop (transitively or intransitively), i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end:--cease, leave, refrain.

G3681.d: probably akin to the base of ὄνομα; notoriety, i.e. a taunt (disgrace):--reproach.

G3575.d: of Hebrew origin (נֹחַ); Noë, (i.e. Noäch), a patriarch:--Noe.

G3910.d: from παρά and a derivative of αὐτός; at the very instant, i.e. momentary:--but for a moment.

G3903.d: from παρά and a derivative of σκεῦος; to furnish aside, i.e. get ready:--prepare self, be (make) ready.

G3822.d: from παλαιός; to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete:--decay, make (wax) old.

G3865.d: from παρά and θεωρέω; to overlook or disregard:--neglect.

G3559.d: from νοῦς and a derivative of τίθημι; calling attention to, i.e. (by implication) mild rebuke or warning:--admonition.

G3755.d: for the genitive case of ὅστις (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst:--whiles.

G3551.d: from a primary (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals); law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle):--law.

G3891.d: from a compound of παρά and νόμος; to be opposed to law, i.e. to transgress:--contrary to law.

G3691.d: probably akin to the base of ἀκμήν ("acid"); keen; by analogy, rapid:--sharp, swift.

G3996.d: from πένθος; to grieve (the feeling or the act):--mourn, (be-)wail.

G3960.d: probably prolongation from παίω; to knock (gently or with a weapon or fatally):--smite, strike. Compare τύπτω.

G3840.d: adverb (of source) from πᾶς; from (i.e. on) all sides:--on every side, round about.

G3927.d: from παρά and the base of ἐπιδημέω; an alien alongside, i.e. a resident foreigner:--pilgrim, stranger.

G3955.d: middle voice from παῤῥησία; to be frank in utterance, or confident in spirit and demeanor:--be (wax) bold, (preach, speak) boldly.

G3918.d: from παρά and εἰμί (including its various forms); to be near, i.e. at hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural) property:--come, X have, be here, + lack, (be here) present.

G3718.d: from a compound of ὀρθός and the base of τομώτερος, to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message):--rightly divide.

G3688.d: apparently a primary word; a donkey:--an ass.

G3836.d: adverb (of source) from πανταχοῦ; from all directions:--from every quarter.

G3557.d: middle voice from (apart or clandestinely); to sequestrate for oneself, i.e. embezzle:--keep back, purloin.

G3655.d: of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm:--shower.

G3997.d: strengthened from the alternate of πάσχω; grief:--mourning, sorrow.

G3884.d: from παρά and λογίζομαι; to misreckon, i.e. delude:--beguile, deceive.

G3719.d: from ὄρθρος; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes:--come early in the morning.

G3716.d: from a compound of ὀρθός and πούς; to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward:--walk uprightly.

G3696.d: probably from a primary (to be busy about); an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war):--armour, instrument, weapon.

G3639.d: from a primary (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment:--destruction.

G3650.d: a primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. complete (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb:--all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.

G3926.d: from παρά and ἐνοχλέω; to harass further, i.e. annoy:--trouble.

G3798.d: from ὀψέ; late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve):--even(-ing, (-tide)).

G3974.d: of uncertain derivation; Paphus, a place in Cyprus:--Paphos.

G3606.d: from ὅς with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction):--from thence, (from) whence, where(-by, -fore, -upon).

G3609.d: from οἶκος; domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent:--(those) of the (his own) house(-hold).

G3987.d: from πεῖρα; to test (subjectively), i.e. (reflexively) to attempt:--assay.

G3786.d: from (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain:--advantageth, profit.

G3796.d: from the same as ὀπίσω (through the idea of backwardness); (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day:--(at) even, in the end.

G3583.d: from ξηρός; to desiccate; by implication, to shrivel, to mature:--dry up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away).

G3686.d: from a presumed derivative of the base of γινώσκω (compare ὀνίνημι); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character):--called, (+ sur-)name(-d).

G3737.d: of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless:--comfortless, fatherless.

G3800.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as ὀψάριον; rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay:-- wages.

G3700.d: a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) ; which is used for it in certain tenses; and both as alternate of ὁράω; to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from βλέπω, which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from εἴδω, which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while θεάομαι, and still more emphatically its intensive θεωρέω, signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and σκοπέω a watching from a distance):--appear, look, see, shew self.

G3645.d: from ὄλεθρος; to spoil, i.e. slay:--destroy.

G3815.d: from παῖς; to sport (as a boy):--play.

G3520.d: probably from the base of ναῦς; an island:--island, isle.

G3989.d: of uncertain affinity; deep or open sea, i.e. the main:--depth, sea.

G3615.d: from οἰκία; familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives:--they (them) of (his own) household.

G3591.d: probably from the same as ἀγκάλη; a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance):--weight.

G3767.d: apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or (conjunctionally) accordingly:--and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore.

G3652.d: probably a contraction from (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian:--Olympas.

G3724.d: from ὅριον; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify:--declare, determine, limit, ordain.

G3813.d: neuter diminutive of παῖς; a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian:--(little, young) child, damsel.

G3506.d: apparently a primary verb; to "nod", i.e. (by analogy), signal:--beckon.

G3663.d: from ὅμοιος and the alternate of πάσχω; similarly affected:--of (subject to) like passions.

G3674.d: genitive case of (the same; akin to ἅμα) as adverb; at the same place or time:--together.

G3690.d: from ὀξύς; vinegar, i.e. sour wine:--vinegar.

G3611.d: from οἶκος; to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit:--dwell. See also οἰκουμένη.

G3902.d: from παρά and the base of σημαίνω; side-marked, i.e. labelled (with a badge (figure-head) of a ship):--sign.

G3584.d: from the base of ξέστης (through the idea of scorching); arid; by implication, shrunken, earth (as opposed to water):--dry land, withered.

G3725.d: neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region):--border, coast.

G3772.d: perhaps from the same as ὄρος (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity):--air, heaven(-ly), sky.

G3616.d: from οἰκοδεσπότης; to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family:--guide the house.

G3827.d: from πᾶς and πολύς; full many, i.e. immense:--very great.

G3526.d: of Latin origin; black; Niger, a Christian:--Niger.

G3812.d: adverb (of source) from παιδίον; from infancy:--of a child.

G3550.d: from νόμος and a derivative of τίθημι; a legislator:--lawgiver.

G3930.d: from παρά and ἔχω; to hold near, i.e. present, afford, exhibit, furnish occasion:--bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, + trouble.

G3505.d: of Latin origin; Neron (i.e. Nero), a Roman emperor:--Nero.

G3952.d: from the present participle of πάρειμι; a being near, i.e. advent (often, return; specially, of Christ to punish Jerusalem, or finally the wicked); (by implication) physically, aspect:--coming, presence.

G3675.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ and φρήν; like-minded, i.e. harmonious:--of one mind.

G3545.d: adverb from a derivative of νόμος; legitimately (specially, agreeably to the rules of the lists):--lawfully.

G3734.d: from a compound of the base of ὅριον and a derivative of τίθημι; a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line:--bound.

G3769.d: apparently a primary word; a tail:--tail.

G3956.d: including all the forms of declension; apparently a primary word; all, any, every, the whole:--all (manner of, means), alway(-s), any (one), X daily, + ever, every (one, way), as many as, + no(-thing), X thoroughly, whatsoever, whole, whosoever.

G3521.d: from νηστεύω; abstinence (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious); specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement:-- fast(-ing).

G3633.d: middle voice apparently from οἷος; to make like (oneself), i.e. imagine (be of the opinion):--suppose, think.

G3703.d: apparently from the base of ὀψέ and ὥρα; properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit:--fruit.

G3736.d: apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig:--dig.

G3879.d: from παρά and κύπτω; to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within):--look (into), stoop down.

G3664.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ; similar (in appearance or character):--like, + manner.

G3857.d: of Oriental origin (compare פַּרְדֵּס); a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise"):--paradise.

G3944.d: from παρά and (to depart); to escape along, i.e. be gone:--past.

G3806.d: from the alternate of πάσχω; properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence):-- (inordinate) affection, lust.

G3706.d: from ὁράω; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance:--sight, vision.

G3870.d: from παρά and καλέω; to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation):--beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray.

G3845.d: from παρά and the base of βάσις; to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command:--(by) transgress(-ion).

G3634.d: probably akin to ὁ, ὅς, and ὅσος; such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so:--so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.

G3766.d: from οὐ and οὖν; is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively) hence or so:--then.

G3971.d: from πατήρ; paternal, i.e. hereditary:--of fathers.

G3580.d: from a compound of ξένος and δέχομαι; to be hospitable:--lodge strangers.

G3673.d: from the base of ὁμοῦ and τέχνη; a fellow-artificer:--of the same craft.

G3641.d: of uncertain affinity; puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat:--+ almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.

G3779.d: adverb from οὗτος; in this way (referring to what precedes or follows):--after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what.

G3754.d: neuter of ὅστις as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes redundant); causative, because:--as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why.

G3720.d: from ὄρθρος; relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day):--morning.

G3819.d: probably another form for πάλιν (through the idea of retrocession); (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient:--any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past.

G3531.d: from Νικόλαος; a Nicolaïte, i.e. adherent of Nicolaüs:--Nicolaitane.

G3699.d: from ὅς and πού; what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot:--in what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever).

G3877.d: from παρά and ἀκολουθέω; to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to:--attain, follow, fully know, have understanding.

G3574.d: from νύξ and ἡμέρα; a day-and-night, i.e. full day of twenty-four hours:--night and day.

G3731.d: from ὁρμή; an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy:--violence.

G3784.d: probably from the base of ὄφελος (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty:--behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should. See also ὄφελον.

G3832.d: adverb from πᾶς and οἶκος; with the whole family:--with all his house.

G3883.d: from a compound of παρά and ἀλλάσσω; transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness:--variableness.

G3549.d: from νομοθέτης; to legislate, i.e. (passively) to have (the Mosaic) enactments injoined, be sanctioned (by them):--establish, receive the law.

G3621.d: from οἰκονόμος; to manage (a house, i.e. an estate):--be steward.

G3667.d: from ὁμοιόω; a form; abstractly, resemblance:--made like to, likeness, shape, similitude.

G3835.d: from πᾶς and ἔργον; all-working, i.e. adroit (shrewd):--crafty.

G3627.d: from (pity); to exercise pity:--have compassion on.

G3701.d: from a presumed derivative of ὀπτάνομαι; visuality, i.e. (concretely) an apparition:--vision.

G3808.d: neuter of a presumed derivative of παῖς; a little boy:--child, lad.

G3896.d: from παρά and πλέω; to sail near:--sail by.

G3975.d: from a derivative of πήγνυμι (meaning thick); to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous):--wax gross.

G3968.d: from παράσημος; a father-land, i.e. native town; (figuratively) heavenly home:--(own) country.

G3612.d: from οἰκέω; a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail:--prison.

G3751.d: of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power:--loin.

G3849.d: from παρά and the middle voice of βιάζω; to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty):--constrain.

G3893.d: from παρά and πικραίνω; to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate:--provoke.

G3682.d: from ὀνίνημι; profitable; Onesimus, a Christian:--Onesimus.

G3507.d: from νέφος; properly, cloudiness, i.e. (concretely) a cloud:--cloud.

G3762.d: from οὐδέ and εἷς; not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing:--any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought.

G3907.d: from παρατηρέω; inspection, i.e. ocular evidence:--obervation.

G3912.d: from παρά and φρονέω; to misthink, i.e. be insane (silly):--as a fool.

G3866.d: from παρατίθημι; a deposit, i.e. (figuratively) trust:--committed unto.

G3775.d: apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally):--ear.

G3517.d: apparently from a derivative of the base of ναῦς (meaning wet); Nereus, a Christian:--Nereus.

G3760.d: adverb from (the feminine) of οὐδείς; by no means:--not.

G3569.d: from neuter plural of ὁ and νῦν; the things now, i.e. (adverbially) at present:--(but) now.

G3588.d: the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom):--the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.

G3770.d: from οὐρανός; celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky:--heavenly.

G3946.d: from παρά and ὅμοιος; alike nearly, i.e. similar:--like.

G3707.d: from ὁράω; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen:--visible.

G3623.d: from οἶκος and the base of νόμος; a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel):--chamberlain, governor, steward.

G3582.d: as if from (properly, to smooth; by implication, (of friction) to boil or heat); a vessel (as fashioned or for cooking) (or perhaps by corruption from the Latin sextarius, the sixth of a modius, i.e. about a pint), i.e. (specially), a measure for liquids or solids, (by analogy, a pitcher):--pot.

G3728.d: from a compound of ὅρκος and a derivative of ὀμνύω; asseveration on oath:--oath.

G3978.d: from the same as πεζῇ; to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land:--go afoot.

G3513.d: probably an intensive form of ναί; a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as sure as:--I protest by.

G3659.d: from ὀπτάνομαι; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye:--eye.

G3632.d: from οἶνος and a form of the base of φλύαρος; an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness):--excess of wine.

G3573.d: from a presumed derivative of νεύω; to nod, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep; figuratively, to delay:--slumber.

G3528.d: from νίκη; to subdue (literally or figuratively):--conquer, overcome, prevail, get the victory.

G3905.d: from παρά and teino (to stretch); to extend along, i.e. prolong (in point of time):--continue.

G3940.d: from πάροικος; foreign residence:--sojourning, X as strangers.

G3525.d: of uncertain affinity; to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e. (figuratively) be discreet:--be sober, watch.

G3969.d: perhaps a contraction for (a compound of πατήρ and βίος); father's life; Patrobas, a Christian:--Patrobas.

G3625.d: feminine participle present passive of οἰκέω (as noun, by implication, of γῆ); land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire:--earth, world.

G3985.d: from πεῖρα; to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline:--assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try.

G3820.d: from πάλαι; antique, i.e. not recent, worn out:--old.

G3512.d: from the comparative of νέος; appertaining to younger persons, i.e. juvenile:--youthful.

G3596.d: from a compound of ὁδός and πορεύομαι; to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel:--go on a journey.

G3709.d: from ὀρέγομαι; properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment:--anger, indignation, vengeance, wrath.

G3535.d: of Hebrew origin (נִינְוֵה); Ninevi (i.e. Nineveh), the capital of Assyria:--Nineve.

G3897.d: neuter of a compound of παρά and the base of πλησίον (as adverb); close by, i.e. (figuratively) almost:--nigh unto.

G3644.d: from ὀλοθρεύω; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent:--destroyer.

G3735.d: probably from an obsolete (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to αἴρω; compare ὄρνις); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain):--hill, mount(-ain).

G3744.d: from ὄζω; fragrance (literally or figuratively):--odour, savour.

G3510.d: of uncertain affinity; a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the inmost mind:--reins.

G3671.d: from the same as ὁμολογέω; acknowledgment:--con- (pro-)fession, professed.

G3739.d: probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article ὁ); the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that:--one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc. See also οὗ.

G3949.d: from παρά and ὀργίζω; to anger alongside, i.e. enrage:--anger, provoke to wrath.

G3745.d: by reduplication from ὅς; as (much, great, long, etc.) as:--all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever).

G3856.d: from παρά and δειγματίζω; to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy:--make a public example, put to an open shame.

G3850.d: from παραβάλλω; a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage:--comparison, figure, parable, proverb.

G3552.d: from νόσος; to be sick, i.e. (by implication, of a diseased appetite) to hanker after (figuratively, to harp upon):--dote.

G3887.d: from παρά and μένω; to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere):--abide, continue.

G3931.d: from a compound of παρά and a derivative of ἀγορά (meaning to harangue an assembly); an address alongside, i.e. (specially), consolation:--comfort.

G3761.d: from οὐ and δέ; not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even:--neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as.

G3741.d: of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from ἱερός, which denotes formal consecration; and from ἅγιος, which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure):--holy, mercy, shalt be. 342

G3983.d: from the same as πένης (through the idea of pinching toil; "pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave:--be an hungered.

G3854.d: from παρά and γίνομαι; to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly:--come, go, be present.

G3540.d: from νοιέω; a perception, i.e. purpose, or (by implication) the intellect, disposition, itself:--device, mind, thought.

G3619.d: feminine (abstract) of a compound of οἶκος and the base of δῶμα; architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation:--building, edify(-ication, -ing).

G3749.d: from ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail:--of earth, earthen.

G3624.d: of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively):--home, house(-hold), temple.

G3586.d: from another form of the base of ξέστης; timber (as fuel or material); by implication, a stick, club or tree or other wooden article or substance:--staff, stocks, tree, wood.

G3976.d: ultimately from πούς; a shackle for the feet:--fetter.

G3922.d: from παρά and εἰσέρχομαι; to come in alongside, i.e. supervene additionally or steathily:--come in privily, enter.

G3841.d: from πᾶς and κράτος; the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign):--Almighty, Omnipotent.

G3803.d: from πήγνυμι; a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation):--snare.

G3954.d: from πᾶς and a derivative of ῥέω; all out-spokenness, i.e. frankness, bluntness, publicity; by implication, assurance:--bold (X -ly, -ness, -ness of speech), confidence, X freely, X openly, X plainly(-ness).

G3794.d: from a remote derivative of ἔχω (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely); a castle (figuratively, argument):--stronghold.

G3579.d: from ξένος; to be a host (passively, a guest); by implication, be (make, appear) strange:--entertain, lodge, (think it) strange.

G3785.d: first person singular of a past tense of ὀφείλω; I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!:--would (to God).

G3942.d: from a compound of παρά and perhaps a derivative of οἴομαι; apparently a state alongside of supposition, i.e. (concretely) an adage; specially, an enigmatical or fictitious illustration:--parable, proverb.

G3970.d: from πατήρ and a derivative of παραδίδωμι (in the sense of handing over or down); traditionary:--received by tradition from fathers.

G3733.d: probably from a prolonged form of the base of ὄρος; a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl):--hen.

G3914.d: from παρά and χειμάζω; to winter near, i.e. stay with over the rainy season:--winter.

G3799.d: from ὀπτάνομαι; properly, sight (the act), i.e. (by implication) the visage, an external show:--appearance, countenance, face.

G3629.d: from οἰκτείρω; compassionate:--merciful, of tender mercy.

G3522.d: from νῆστις; to abstain from food (religiously):--fast.

G3957.d: of Chaldee origin (compare פֶּסַח); the Passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it):--Easter, Passover.

G3881.d: from παρά and the middle voice of λέγω (in its original sense); (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past:--pass, sail by.

G3607.d: of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail:--sheet.

G3727.d: from (a fence; perhaps akin to ὅριον); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath):--oath.

G3876.d: from παρακούω; inattention, i.e. (by implication) disobedience:--disobedience.

G3581.d: apparently a primary word; foreign (literally, alien, or figuratively, novel); by implication, a guest or (vice-versa) entertainer:--host, strange(-r).

G3543.d: from νόμος; properly, to do by law (usage), i.e. to accustom (passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard:-- suppose, thing, be wont.

G3530.d: from νῖκος and δῆμος; victorious among his people; Nicodemus, an Israelite:--Nicodemus.

G3867.d: from παρά and αἰνέω; to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course):--admonish, exhort.

G3947.d: from παρά and a derivative of ὀξύς; to sharpen alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate:--easily provoke, stir.

G3873.d: from παρά and κεῖμαι; to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy):--be present.

G3651.d: from ὅλος and τέλος; complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect:--wholly.

G3994.d: feminine of πενθερός; a wife's mother:--mother in law, wife's mother.

G3863.d: from παρά and ζηλόω; to stimulate alongside, i.e. excite to rivalry:--provoke to emulation (jealousy).

G3818.d: feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia:--Pacatiana.

G3928.d: from παρά and ἔρχομαι; to come near or aside, i.e. to approach (arrive), go by (or away), (figuratively) perish or neglect, (causative) avert:--come (forth), go, pass (away, by, over), past, transgress.

G3868.d: from παρά and the middle voice of αἰτέω; to beg off, i.e. deprecate, decline, shun:--avoid, (make) excuse, intreat, refuse, reject.

G3717.d: probably from the base of ὄρος; right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct:--straight, upright.

G3938.d: from παρά and ὁδός; a by-road, i.e. (actively) a route:--way.

G3515.d: from νήπιος; to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently:--be a child.

G3862.d: from παραδίδωμι; transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law:--ordinance, tradition.

G3828.d: from a compound of πᾶς and πυρά; every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous (χώρα being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pamphylia.

G3620.d: from the same as οἰκοδομή; confirmation:--edifying.

G3565.d: from a primary but obsolete verb (to veil as a bride; compare Latin "nupto," to marry); a young married woman (as veiled), including a betrothed girl; by implication, a son's wife:--bride, daughter in law.

G3831.d: from πᾶς and a derivative of ἀγορά; a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively) universal companionship:--general assembly.

G3594.d: from ὁδηγός; to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach)):--guide, lead.

G3656.d: from ὅμιλος; to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse:--commune, talk.

G3529.d: apparently a primary word; conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) the means of success:--victory.

G3764.d: from οὐδέ and -πω; not even yet:--as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet.

G3533.d: from νῖκος and πόλις; victorious city; Nicopolis, a place in Macedonia:--Nicopolis.

G3934.d: probably of foreign origin; a Parthian, i.e. inhabitant of Parthia:--Parthian.

G3963.d: of uncertain derivation; Patmus, an islet in the Mediterranean:--Patmos.

G3899.d: from παρά and πορεύομαι; to travel near:--go, pass (by).

G3783.d: from (the alternate of) ὀφείλω; something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault:--debt.

G3610.d: from οἰκέω; a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic:--(household) servant.

G3757.d: genitive case of ὅς as adverb; at which place, i.e. where:--where(-in), whither(-soever).

G3809.d: from παιδεύω; tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction:--chastening, chastisement, instruction, nurture.

G3566.d: from νύμφη; a bride-groom (literally or figuratively):--bridegroom.

G3689.d: adverb of the oblique cases of ὤν; really:--certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily.

G3773.d: of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian:--Urbanus.

G3804.d: from a presumed derivative of πάθος; something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence:-- affection, affliction, motion, suffering.

G3750.d: from a derivative of ὄζω; smell (the sense):--smelling.

G3941.d: from παρά and οἶκος; having a home near, i.e. (as noun) a by-dweller (alien resident):--foreigner, sojourn, stranger.

G3992.d: apparently a primary verb; to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas (as a stronger form of ) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and στέλλω denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield:--send, thrust in.

G3895.d: from παρά and πίπτω; to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize:--fall away.

G3900.d: from παραπίπτω; a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression:--fall, fault, offence, sin, trespass.

G3614.d: from οἶκος; properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics):--home, house(-hold).

G3846.d: from παρά and βάλλω; to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken:--arrive, compare.

G3748.d: from ὅς and τὶς; which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same:--X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever). Compare ὅτι.

G3811.d: from παῖς; to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment):--chasten(-ise), instruct, learn, teach.

G3924.d: from παρά and ἐκτός; near outside, i.e. besides:--except, saving, without.

G3631.d: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (יַיִן)); "wine" (literally or figuratively):--wine.

G3740.d: multiple adverb from ὅς; how (i.e. with ἄν, so) many times as:--as oft(-en) as.

G3859.d: from a compound of παρά and διατρίβω; misemployment, i.e. meddlesomeness:--perverse disputing.

G3858.d: from παρά and δέχομαι; to accept near, i.e. admit or (by implication) delight in:--receive.

G3705.d: from ὁράω; something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural):--sight, vision.

G3984.d: from the base of πέραν (through the idea of piercing); a test, i.e. attempt, experience:--assaying, trial.

G3833.d: from a compound of πᾶς and ὅπλον; full armor ("panoply"):--all (whole) armour.

G3972.d: of Latin origin; (little; but remotely from a derivative of παύω, meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an apostle:--Paul, Paulus.

G3547.d: from νόμος and διδάσκαλος; an expounder of the (Jewish) law, i.e. a Rabbi:--doctor (teacher) of the law.

G3602.d: from a derivative of the base of δύνω; moaning, i.e. lamentation:--mourning.

G3834.d: from πανοῦργος; adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry:--(cunning) craftiness, subtilty.

G3561.d: feminine of a compound of νέος and μήν (as noun by implication, of ἡμέρα); the festival of new moon:--new moon.

G3951.d: from παρά and (to spur); to urge along, i.e. stimulate (to hostility):--stir up.

G3578.d: from ξένος; hospitality, i.e. (by implication) a place of entertainment:--lodging.

G3915.d: from παραχειμάζω; a wintering over:--winter in.

G3763.d: from οὐδέ and ποτέ; not even at any time, i.e. never at all:--neither at any time, never, nothing at any time.

G3789.d: probably from ὀπτάνομαι (through the idea of sharpness of vision); a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially Satan:--serpent.

G3988.d: from a presumed derivative of πείθω; persuadableness, i.e. credulity:--persuasion.

G3838.d: from πᾶς and τέλος; full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion):--+ in (no) wise, uttermost.

G3923.d: from παρά and εἰσφέρω; to bear in alongside, i.e. introduce simultaneously:--give.

G3516.d: from an obsolete particle (implying negation) and ἔπος; not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian:--babe, child (+ -ish).

G3694.d: from the same as ὄπισθεν with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e. aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun):--after, back(-ward), (+ get) behind, + follow.

G3713.d: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare ὄρος); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long for):--covet after, desire.

G3979.d: dative case feminine of a derivative of πούς (as adverb); foot-wise, i.e. by walking:--a- (on) foot.

G3965.d: as if feminine of a derivative of πατήρ; paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation):--family, kindred, lineage.

G3964.d: from πατήρ and the same as the latter part of μητραλῴας; a parricide:--murderer of fathers.

G3781.d: from ὀφείλω; an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God):--debtor, which owed, sinner.

G3842.d: from πᾶς and ὅτε; every when, i.e. at all times:--alway(-s), ever(-more).

G3830.d: from the same as πανδοχεῖον; an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai):--host.

G3993.d: from a primary (to toil for daily subsistence); starving, i.e. indigent:--poor. Compare πτωχός.

G3945.d: from παρόμοιος; to resemble:--be like unto.

G3990.d: from a derivative of πλήσσω (meaning an axe); to chop off (the head), i.e. truncate:--behead.

G3676.d: adverb from the base of ὁμοῦ; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still:--and even, nevertheless, though but.

G3692.d: probably from ὀπτάνομαι; a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water):--cave, place.

G3527.d: probably from νικάω; victorious; Nicanor, a Christian:--Nicanor.

G3532.d: from νῖκος and λαός; victorious over the people; Nicolaüs, a heretic:--Nicolaus.
